answers.core: The changes can't be made in an add-on, and the workarounds mentioned above are needlessly complex for a simple feature.
answers.workaround:
Changing the color of the black bars can be done by creating a solid color texture and setting the black bar texture to that, like this:
```gdscript
var black_bar_texture = preload("res://black_bars.png")	
var t_id = black_bar_texture.get_rid()
VisualServer.black_bars_set_images(t_id, t_id, t_id, t_id)
```
But it's a weird workaround. Changing the other settings I mentioned aren't possible. It is possible to create a scene with a viewport, and use that viewport as your game's main viewport, and then you can do whatever you want behind the viewport. But this is a lot of extra work and requires the game's scene tree to be completely changed.

title: Add more options for customizing the VisualServer black bars
